name: Explícamelo
source:
Alone in a cell, Hidde dreams of Panini. His past comes back, and the dream fades. He wakes to reality, with Panini’s hope nearby.

[From [url=https://naugames.itch.io/explicamelo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
希德独自一人在牢房里，梦见了帕尼尼。他的过去又回来了，梦想也消失了。他醒悟到现实，帕尼尼的希望就在身边。

[来自[url=https://naugames.itch.io/explicamelo]Itch.io[/url]]
